payload.title: Target-calibrated active sensing + versioned visual evidence cache falsifier
payload.work_clay: After the existing target-VPS runtime sanity and VisionFeatureTap work has a stable runtime configuration, execute the PBC coverage-debt and VEC lifetime/version matrices from Q23-T-PBC-COVERAGE-01 and Q23-T-VEC-LIFETIME-01. Reuse the same frozen image/action fixtures and runtime/model/mmproj hashes where possible. Compare against FULL_FRAME, ROI_PLUS_CONTEXT, HYBRID_PERIODIC_ANCHOR, NO_CACHE and NATIVE_RUNTIME_CACHE_ONLY. Include wrong-confidence/interface-shift, hidden-operation, visual-alias, source-epoch, mmproj/preprocess/projection/token-budget swap, crash/restart and concurrent-slot controls. Do not promote from token savings alone.
payload.reason_clay: Primary libmtmd source makes synchronous feature tapping physically plausible but does not establish safe raw-pointer persistence beyond the owning batch. Current GUI research supports active crop/zoom while current UQ evidence shows confidence calibration does not transfer reliably across model/interface regimes. The discriminating test is therefore exact target-runtime calibration plus coverage-debt and ownership/version controls, not another generic ROI heuristic.
payload.completion_clay: Raw rows and exact metadata exist for all variants; model/runtime-specific calibration is frozen; hidden-operation and grounding failures are measured; vision encode and full-decoder invocation counts are recorded; stale/version mismatch reuse is zero or explicitly failed; native runtime cache behavior is measured rather than assumed; PBC and VEC each receive SUPPORTED/REFINED/REFUTED/NO_CHANGE; rollback is verified; no H1/H2/H3 or BASE credit is granted except under their independent acceptance contracts.
invalidators: A newer exact target-runtime receipt already executes the same PBC/VEC matrix
VisionFeatureTap is refuted or selected target multimodal runtime changes materially
A simpler hybrid-anchor/native-cache baseline already dominates under the same fixtures and budgets
payload.executor_policy: Do not displace or slow the active ClayCode BASE critical path. Execute only with spare compatible target-VPS capacity or when the same run directly unblocks H1/H2 perception acceptance. Refresh repo/head, work revisions and target capability before effect. No paid/final training.
